# Awesome NSH

> Curated directory and machine-readable catalog of 43 Native Shell (nsh) resources, including 13 installable nshm modules verified with `nsh add` on nsh 0.7.1 (updated 2026-11-26).

Native Shell (nsh) is a Rust-first native UI framework targeting iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, GPUI, TUI, and Web. An installable `nshm` requires `#[native_module("...")]` in its Rust crate root, `nsh.json` `"exports"` for TSX modules, or `nsh.json` `"platform"` for community platform targets. The 19 official `longbridge/nsh` framework crates listed in this catalog are NOT `nshm` packages and cannot be installed with `nsh add`.

Source distribution among the 13 verified `nshm` modules: 7 via crates.io, 5 via `github:owner/repo`, and 1 via Git URL `--rev`. Verification scope covers clean scratch-app `nsh add` resolution on nsh 0.7.1, not cross-platform on-device runtime builds.

## Core Pages

- [Home Directory (Markdown)](https://nsh-awesome.vercel.app/index.md): Content-equivalent Markdown version of the full 43-entry Awesome NSH directory.
- [Discovery Methodology (Markdown)](https://nsh-awesome.vercel.app/discovery.md): Empirical manifest rules, 6 discovery channels (119 crates.io crates, 89 GitHub repos), and nsh 0.7.1 verification ledger.
- [About & Curation Criteria (Markdown)](https://nsh-awesome.vercel.app/about.md): Maintainer background, inclusion and rejection rules, and honest verification boundaries.
- [Installable nshm Hub](https://nsh-awesome.vercel.app/nshm/): 13 curated entries — Modules verified with `nsh add` in a clean scratch app on nsh 0.7.1 (from crates.io, `github:owner/repo`, or Git URL).
- [Framework & Official Crates Hub](https://nsh-awesome.vercel.app/framework/): 19 curated entries — NOT nshm — cannot be installed with `nsh add`. Core framework, runtime, bundler, and platform backend crates maintained in `longbridge/nsh` (`cargo add` or managed automatically by `nsh`).
- [Examples & Templates Hub](https://nsh-awesome.vercel.app/templates/): 4 curated entries — Starter boilerplates, official examples, showcase catalogs, and production reference applications built with Native Shell.
- [Articles & Tutorials Hub](https://nsh-awesome.vercel.app/guides/): 7 curated entries — Official documentation, architecture guides, and module authoring references for Native Shell.
- [Awesome NSH: Native Shell Modules & Crate Directory](https://nsh-awesome.vercel.app/): Explore 13 verified Native Shell (nshm) packages, 19 core framework crates, starter templates, and official guides with nsh 0.7.1 checks and index.json.
- [How Native Shell nshm Discovery & Verification Work](https://nsh-awesome.vercel.app/discovery/): Empirical results from auditing 119 crates.io crates and 89 GitHub repos on NSH 0.7.1: four manifest kinds, the Cargo 0.6 quirk, and rejection logs.
- [About Awesome NSH: Verification & Safety Policy](https://nsh-awesome.vercel.app/about/): Maintainer details for AkaraChen, how scratch-app nsh 0.7.1 install checks work, build.rs and proc-macro security boundaries, and contribution rules.

## Machine-Readable Endpoints

- [JSON Catalog Index (index.json)](https://nsh-awesome.vercel.app/index.json): Canonical machine-readable JSON feed of all 43 entries, 13 installable nshms, sections, and categories.
- [Verified Module Count Badge JSON (count.json)](https://nsh-awesome.vercel.app/count.json): Shields.io endpoint reporting 13 verified installable nshm modules.
- [Full Reference Documentation (llms-full.txt)](https://nsh-awesome.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Complete self-contained Markdown reference covering all 43 catalog entries, install commands, and discovery findings.
- [ARD 1.0 AI Resource Catalog (ai-catalog.json)](https://nsh-awesome.vercel.app/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Agentic Resource Discovery 1.0 manifest registering Awesome NSH feeds and directories.

## Verified Installable nshm Modules

- [nsh-extra](https://nsh-awesome.vercel.app/nshm/nsh-extra.md): Official optional device modules for NSH apps gated by Cargo features: camera, location, photos, push, and speech. Install: `nsh add nsh-extra --features camera`. Platforms: iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Web. License: Apache-2.0.
- [nsh-omarchy](https://nsh-awesome.vercel.app/nshm/nsh-omarchy.md): Omarchy-themed UI component set built on nsh-base with live system theme following, forms, overlays, tables, and charts for Rust and TSX. Install: `nsh add nsh-omarchy`. Platforms: macOS, Linux, Windows, iOS, Android, Web. License: MIT.
- [nsh-shadcn](https://nsh-awesome.vercel.app/nshm/nsh-shadcn.md): Rust-backed shadcn/ui new-york-v4 component port drawn with native views across desktop, mobile, and web for both Rust and TSX. Install: `nsh add github:caoxing9/nsh-shadcn`. Platforms: macOS, iOS, Android, Windows, Linux, Web. License: MIT.
- [nsh-widgets](https://nsh-awesome.vercel.app/nshm/nsh-widgets.md): Cross-platform home-screen widgets and Live Activities using one shared Widget Tree IR rendered natively via WidgetKit, RemoteViews, Plasma, and GNOME. Install: `nsh add https://github.com/SuperNSH/widgets.git --rev master`. Platforms: iOS, macOS, Android, Linux. License: MIT.
- [nsh-icon](https://nsh-awesome.vercel.app/nshm/nsh-icon.md): Tree-shaken vector icon renderer (`<Icon>` and `icon()`) paired with five installable icon-set crates (Lucide, Heroicons, Tabler, Phosphor, Remix). Install: `nsh add nsh-icon`. Platforms: macOS, iOS, Android, Windows, Linux, Web. License: Apache-2.0.
- [supernsh-icons](https://nsh-awesome.vercel.app/nshm/supernsh-icons.md): Typed SVG and font-glyph icon library covering 260 Iconify sets (~465,000 icons) with 35 installable companion set crates. Install: `nsh add supernsh-icons`. Platforms: macOS, iOS, Android, Windows, Linux, Web. License: MIT.
- [nsh-graph](https://nsh-awesome.vercel.app/nshm/nsh-graph.md): Interactive network graph component on native `<Canvas>` with force, hierarchical, circular, and grid layouts plus an opt-in Rust backend. Install: `nsh add nsh-graph`. Platforms: iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, GPUI, Web. License: Apache-2.0.
- [nsh-o11y](https://nsh-awesome.vercel.app/nshm/nsh-o11y.md): High-throughput observability charts (`TimeSeriesChart`, `LogView`, `TraceWaterfall`, `FlameGraph`) using M4 pyramid decimation and an optional Rust store. Install: `nsh add nsh-o11y`. Platforms: iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, GPUI, Web. License: Apache-2.0.
- [nsh-webgpu](https://nsh-awesome.vercel.app/nshm/nsh-webgpu.md): WebGPU (`navigator.gpu`, `GPUDevice`, `<Canvas getContext("webgpu")>`) for NSH apps ported from react-native-webgpu onto wgpu 29. Install: `nsh add github:SuperNSH/webgpu`. Platforms: macOS, iOS, Android, Windows, Linux, Web. License: MIT.
- [nsh-skia](https://nsh-awesome.vercel.app/nshm/nsh-skia.md): Skia 2D canvas and drawing primitives (`<Canvas>`, `<Circle>`, `<Path>`, `Skia.RuntimeEffect`) backed by `skia-safe` for macOS and Linux. Install: `nsh add github:SuperNSH/skia`. Platforms: macOS, Linux. License: MIT.
- [nsh-query](https://nsh-awesome.vercel.app/nshm/nsh-query.md): Pure-TSX TanStack Query adapter (`useQuery`, `useMutation`, persistence) wired to NSH app lifecycle, network status, and `Storage`. Install: `nsh add github:Dearest/nsh-query`. Platforms: iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, Web. License: MIT.
- [nsmetry](https://nsh-awesome.vercel.app/nshm/nsmetry.md): Privacy-first event analytics client SDK for NSH apps with batching and retries targeting a self-hosted NsMetry Cloudflare Worker. Install: `nsh add nsmetry`. Platforms: macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, iOS, Web. License: MIT.
- [nsh-platform-harmonyos](https://nsh-awesome.vercel.app/nshm/nsh-platform-harmonyos.md): Community platform nshm providing `--target harmonyos` to run and package NSH apps natively on HarmonyOS and OpenHarmony with ArkUI. Install: `nsh add github:huacnlee/nsh-platform-harmonyos`. Platforms: HarmonyOS, OpenHarmony. License: Apache-2.0.
